title: Discount Program Courtesy on Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Late Fees
content:
**Courtesy schedule.** A late fee on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan) is multiplied by the program courtesy share for the discount program on the financed contract: the military or first-responder program takes the service courtesy share of 80%; the senior program takes the senior courtesy share of 90%; no program leaves the figure whole.

The discount program is the single program recorded at signing on the contract the account finances — the Window Replacement Contracts contract or the Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract it funds.

| Discount program on the financed contract | Late fee multiplied by |
|---|---|
| Military | 80% |
| First responder | 80% |
| Senior | 90% |
| None | 100% (left whole) |

The share multiplies the late fee figure before it is rounded; the late fee is rounded to the cent only as the final figure, to the nearest cent with an exact half cent rounding up.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A late fee figure of 30.00 on a contract carrying the senior program: 30.00 times 90% is 27.00.
- A late fee figure of 12.35 on a contract carrying the military program: 12.35 times 80% is 9.88.
- A late fee figure of 12.35 on a contract with no program: 12.35.
